title: Add integration test for PayPal missing-credentials checkout path
body: Write an integration test that mocks getPaymentEnv to throw missing-credentials error and verifies the checkout route returns 503. Currently only unit-level substring matching is tested in checkout-validation.spec.ts. An integration test would exercise the full error propagation through createPayPalOrder.
rationale: The existing tests mock createPayPalOrder to succeed, so the missing-credentials 503 path is not exercised in integration tests. A full integration test would require mocking getPaymentEnv at the module level.
